projects.title: DoodhOS — Milk Collection Center Management
projects.description: A modern SaaS platform for managing milk collection centers with offline support, billing, and analytics.
projects.longDescription: DoodhOS is a full-stack, multi-tenant SaaS platform designed for dairy and milk collection centers. It streamlines milk procurement, customer management, fat/SNF calculations, billing, payments, and reporting while supporting offline-first workflows for rural areas.
projects.problem: Traditional milk collection centers rely on manual registers and outdated software, resulting in billing errors, delayed payments, and inefficient operations.
projects.solution: A centralized cloud-based platform that automates milk collection, payment tracking, customer management, and reporting with offline capabilities and real-time synchronization.
features: Multi-tenant architecture for multiple collection centers

projects.title: Accrual — Smart Billing Platform
projects.description: A modern billing and invoicing platform for small businesses with customer management and business insights.
projects.longDescription: Accrual is a full-stack billing solution that helps businesses generate professional invoices, manage customers, track payments, and gain valuable business insights from a single dashboard.
projects.problem: Many small businesses still use paper bill books or spreadsheets, making invoicing, payment tracking, and customer management time-consuming and error-prone.
projects.solution: A cloud-based billing platform that simplifies invoice generation, customer management, payment tracking, and business analytics through an intuitive interface.
features: Responsive dashboard for desktop and mobile

projects.title: HireLens — AI Resume Builder
projects.description: AI-powered resume builder with live editor, ATS scoring, and smart content suggestions.
projects.longDescription: HireLens is an intelligent resume-building platform that helps job seekers craft professional, ATS-friendly resumes in minutes. It combines a smart live editor with recruiter-approved templates, instant ATS score analysis, and AI-driven content suggestions.
projects.problem: Job seekers struggle to create resumes that pass automated screening systems, losing opportunities before a human ever reads their application.
projects.solution: A unified platform that combines real-time ATS scoring, AI-powered content recommendations, and professional templates — reducing resume creation time from hours to minutes.
features: Live preview editor with drag-and-drop sections
Instant ATS compatibility score with improvement tips
Export to PDF with pixel-perfect formatting

projects.title: SkyBox Cloud Storage
projects.description: Secure cloud storage platform with authentication, file sharing, and permission-based access control.
projects.longDescription: SkyBox is a full-stack cloud storage solution enabling users to upload, organize, and securely access files from anywhere. Built on Appwrite for reliable storage, database, and authentication services.
projects.problem: Teams needed a lightweight, self-controlled file sharing solution without the cost and complexity of enterprise storage products.
projects.solution: A streamlined cloud storage application with two-step OTP verification, role-based file permissions, and instant secure sharing between registered users.
features: File preview for images and documents

projects.title: Toolbox — Developer Utilities
projects.description: Full-stack developer productivity platform with essential utilities and AI-powered tools.
projects.longDescription: Toolbox consolidates the most-needed developer utilities into a single, fast dashboard — from file converters and image optimizers to JSON formatters and AI-powered code helpers.
projects.problem: Developers constantly switch between dozens of fragmented browser tools, wasting time and risking data privacy with third-party services.
projects.solution: A unified, privacy-first developer toolbox that runs all utilities client-side where possible, with serverless APIs for heavy processing tasks.
features: JSON / YAML / XML formatters and validators
Regex tester with live match highlighting
Color palette generator and contrast checker

projects.title: MiniURL — Link Shortener
projects.description: Scalable URL shortener with analytics, QR code generation, and custom slug support.
projects.longDescription: MiniURL is a high-performance link management service offering instant URL shortening, QR code generation, and click analytics. Built for speed with sub-50ms redirect latency.
projects.problem: Existing free URL shorteners are cluttered with ads, lack analytics, and don't support custom branded slugs for professional use.
projects.solution: A clean, ad-free link shortener with custom slugs, real-time click analytics, and QR code generation — all available without account creation.
features: Custom slug creation for branded links
QR code generation with download options
API access for programmatic link creation
Bulk URL shortening via CSV upload
